nom: Cetaphil Vitamin C Serum with Niacinamide and Sunflower Seed Oil

segments.oily: One reviewer with sometimes-oily skin reports no issues from the serum.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the serum leaves their face refreshed and less dry, with one saying it restored moisture after sun exposure and another still finding her skin dry despite use.
segments.combination: The two reviewers who describe combination skin report the serum feels good and causes no irritation.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers most often report no irritation, no stinging and no breakouts, though one reports her skin "broke out" after starting it and another's 17-year-old had her face burn badly.
segments.normal: The one reviewer identifying as having normal skin reports no breakouts and enjoys the feel.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing mature or aging skin report smoother, hydrated skin and softened fine lines, with one 62-year-old and others crediting it for expression lines around the eyes.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers report softened fine lines and expression lines, smoother and more hydrated skin with regular use; effects are described as gradual rather than dramatic.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin report the serum restores moisture, keeps skin from feeling dry through the day, and pairs well with a moisturizer on top; one reviewer's skin still felt dry after use.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea-related redness reports visible improvement in redness alongside brighter, clearer skin.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer notes her skin can be sensitive to niacinamide in high concentrations but experienced no reaction or discomfort with this formula.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers targeting dark spots or hyperpigmentation report fading or reduced appearance over weeks of use; a few report no visible reduction yet or are still waiting for results.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers using it on acne scars report fading of the scars; one reviewer with a history of cystic acne reports it does not clog pores, while another reports new breakouts appearing after starting the product.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer states the serum did not make her skin oily despite testing it during humid summer days.

aspects.libelle: Glitter or shimmer particles in formula
Clear glass packaging risks vitamin C degradation
Mild pilling under heavy moisturizer or sunscreen

extraits.texte: My 17 used it for the first time and it burned her face really bad

I'm not entirely sure of these just yet. I will say I like how they feel on my face and they are refreshing to use at night. My face doesn't feel as dry as it had been. However, it is a bit broken out now and wasn't before. I'm unsure if it's from them or stress though so I don't want to blame the serums just yet and am going to take a break and try again in the future. Ingredient and feel wise, and the moisurization though are all great!

My skin looks smooth, hydrated, and fine lines have softened. Also, my sensitive skin loves this product and it absorbs quickly (no stickiness) and my dry skin is instantly refreshed. I do believe it is also the combination of products.

I have very sensitive skin. Changing skin care products does not go well for me. During the cold winter months my usual face moisturizer wasn't cutting it. Using this after I wash and under my face lotion is the perfect balance I need. This has improved my skins brightness, texture and clarity! It even helps with redness/rosacea!

I've been trying out the Cetaphil Vitamin C Serum and I have to say, I'm loving it! One of the standout things about this serum is that it has both vitamin C and niacinamide. The best part? Niacinamide is listed as number three on the ingredients list, which is a huge plus in my book. Another thing I really appreciate is that it's fragrance-free and paraben-free, which is great for someone like me with a history of cystic acne. (You can check my previous posts for more on that!) This serum doesn't clog my pores at all, and it's hypoallergenic, which is a relief because I'm always cautious about new products. It makes my skin feel so radiant and gives it an instant boost. I can already tell this is going to be a staple in my routine, and I can't wait to see the long-term results!

I really liked this serum. After spending so much time in the sun this summer my face was left feeling very dry and damaged. This serum not only had helped restore moisture in my face but it also helped kept my scars from getting darker and reduced the appearance of my dark spots. I like that it doesn't have a fragrance and is safe on my sensitive skin. There is a shimmer/glow to this serum.

Sensitive to vitamin C?! Not with Cetaphil, it helps my dry/sensitive skin with any dark spots or need a glow to my routine. No irritation to my skin. It keeps my skin from being dry and helps with any dark spots. Great vitamin C serum for sensitive skin people!
